name: big_view_change
description: Rotate the head 150deg and translate the viewpoint, then hold (no reset). Used by the end-to-end operate->observe test: injecting this via the Monado adapter makes an OpenXR app (hello_xr) re-render a visibly different view, which the PlaySpectra capture layer then observes as a changed PNG. Writer disconnect holds the state (spec 5.3), so post-injection frames keep the new view.
